comments: a35d6e9b: This routine is used to queue up a job to run at a later time. It collects information needed for the queue, and sets up environment variables for the queued routine.
09eabd43: Save the current date/time in $HOROLOG format.
26f0a94e: If $PRINCIPAL is not defined and ION is null, set ZTIO to null. This is related to queued job I/O handling.
7aa97e54: If ZTDESC is not defined, set it based on DGPGM, PGM, or a default string.
db18968e: If ZTRTN is not defined, set it based on DGPGM, PGM, or go to CLOSE label. Set ZTRTN to the entry point for when the queued job starts running.
5aebcd11: If DGZTSAVE or VAR is defined, save that value to be restored when the queued job starts. DGZTSAVE will be used to save arrays/variables for the job.
f45716b1: If DGPGM is defined but not saved in ZTSAVE, add it to ZTSAVE.
90cd8c4c: Call %ZTLOAD to queue the job, display message, and set X to quit or continue based on if job was successfully queued.
bd268caf: End of QUE label.
9bc2f92b: Open device for queuing job. If queued, call QUE and set POP=1 to quit. If not queued, use current device.
ac410a16: Use the opened device.
a0d3bc55: If DGZTSAVE contains '#', loop through values in DGZTSAVE. For each value, if it's not already saved in ZTSAVE, add it. If value ends with '(', save the part before '(' in ZTSAVE too.
07e2a048: End of SAVE label.
55f00dfb: Replace '#' in DGZTSAVE with '(' to flag start of array name.
85a7248c: End of ARRAY label.
3fa501a9: If ZTQUEUED is defined, quit. Otherwise close current device.
ea8a0bbc: Kill all variables used by this routine.
d72f5157: End of END label.
3468ebe2: Execute the program specified by DGPGM, PGM, or go to CLOSE label.
947574fb: Kill variables related to queued job, then go to CLOSE label.
261a0bd0: End of DQ label.
587a47d3: If ZTSK("D") is defined, parse it to get the queued job date/time and store in DGX and Z variables in $HOROLOG format.
3e99cf5c: End of DTQ label.
